sites.name: Site name
sites.background: Background worker (no domain, e.g. queue worker)

processes.title: Extra processes
processes.help: Run more programs from the same build, e.g. an API next to the web app, or a queue worker. Each gets its own port in $PORT (and PORT_<NAME> for the others). Give a path like /api/* to send that part of the site's domains to it; leave the path empty for background workers.
processes.redisHelp: A Redis only this site can use (password-protected, 256 MB, data kept across deploys). REDIS_URL is set for the app, its processes and the build.

github.notConfigured: The GitHub App is not set up on this server yet, so only public repositories can be deployed. An admin can add it in apps/api/.env.

domains.pathRulesHint: Send part of this domain to another app, e.g. /api/* → your API site. Everything else goes to this site.

databases.name: Name
databases.passwordOnce: Save this password now. You can reveal it again later from this page.

settings.scan: Add this secret to Google Authenticator, Authy or 1Password, then enter the 6-digit code.
settings.nightly: Run nightly backups of every account
settings.keep: Copies to keep on this server
settings.remote: Also copy to S3-compatible storage (Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Wasabi)
settings.keepSecret: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.dnsHint: Connect Cloudflare to manage DNS records from the panel and to issue wildcard certificates (*.example.com).
settings.cfAccount: Needed only to create new zones from the panel

backups.none: No backups yet. Nightly backups run automatically once enabled by the admin.
backups.hint: Each backup holds the live version of every site (with uploads) and a dump of every database. Restoring replaces the current files/data of what you tick.
backups.restoreWarn: This replaces the current files of the chosen sites and the current data of the chosen databases with the copy from this backup.

dns.notConfigured: DNS management is not set up yet. An admin can connect Cloudflare under Server.
dns.addZoneHint: The domain must be in your Cloudflare account, or the admin must allow creating zones.
dns.setNameservers: Set these nameservers at your domain registrar:

access.title: SFTP / SSH access
access.sftp: Allow SFTP (files only, starts in your sites folder)
access.shell: Allow SSH shell and the web terminal
access.shellAdmin: an admin can turn this on
access.passwordHint: 12+ characters. Or use SSH keys below (safer).
access.keysHint: One per line, e.g. the contents of ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

cron.name: Name
cron.commandHint: Runs in the app folder as your user, with the site's environment variables. Output goes to the cron log.

terminal.notAllowed: The web terminal needs SSH shell access for this account. An admin can turn it on under SFTP & usage.
terminal.hint: Runs as the account's Linux user inside its CPU/RAM limits. Closes after 30 minutes without input.

ssl.customNow: This domain uses your uploaded certificate.
ssl.dnsNow: This wildcard gets its certificate through the DNS provider automatically.
ssl.autoNow: This domain gets a free Let's Encrypt certificate automatically. Upload your own only if you need a specific certificate (e.g. EV/OV).

email.noDomains: No mail domains yet. Add a domain you own to create mailboxes like you@yourdomain.com.
email.domainHint: A domain added under Domains or DNS for this account
email.confirmDeleteMailbox: Delete {{name}} and all its mail? This cannot be undone.
email.toHint: One or more addresses, separated by commas
email.catchAllHint: Mail to unknown addresses at {{domain}} goes here. Leave empty to reject it.
email.dnsHelp: Create these records at your DNS provider so mail reaches this server and is trusted by Gmail, Outlook and others.
email.confirmDeleteDomain: Remove email for {{name}}? All mailboxes and their mail are deleted.

apps.intro: Install a ready-to-use app on one of your domains in a few minutes.
apps.domainHint: Point this domain at the server first (DNS A record)
apps.startedHelp: The install runs in the background. Follow it on the site page.
apps.adminOnce: Save these now: the admin password is shown only once.

resellers.intro: Resellers create and manage their own hosting accounts within the limits you set.
resellers.name: Name
resellers.packagesHint: Plans this reseller may give to their customers
resellers.myUsage: Your reseller plan: {{accounts}} of {{maxAccounts}} accounts · {{disk}} of {{maxDisk}} GB disk

servers.intro: Add more servers to host accounts on. They connect to this panel over a private encrypted network.
servers.notReady: Multi-server is not set up on this panel yet. Re-run install.sh on this server to enable it.
servers.name: Name
servers.joinHelp: Run this as root on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 server:
servers.joinNote: The command works once and expires in 24 hours. The new server needs UDP port 51888 open to this server.
